title: BAY81-8781, I.V. Aspirin in the Indication of Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS)

sections.abstract: The objective of this study is to investigate whether intravenous administration (injected into a vein) of acetylsalicylic acid (Aspirin) in doses of 250 and 500 mg is superior to oral treatment of ACS with tablets containing 300 mg of Aspirin.
